facts.anchor: Frasier had gone straight to the hospital after the game, wanting nothing more than to be with Bryn.

facts.fact: 冰上secret smile：奖杯像共同成就
facts.anchor: But it was the pride radiating from her, the secret smile we’d shared, that had meant everything to me.

facts.fact: 她的“不想结束”终于让两人同页
facts.anchor: Fucking finally. Finally, we were on the same page, because I didn’t want it to end either.

facts.fact: 他意识到I loved her（决定清醒时才说）
facts.anchor: She was so confident, so sure of herself, and I loved that about her. I loved her.

facts.fact: 表白计划：必须两人清醒
facts.anchor: when I finally told her how I felt, I fully intended that both of us would be completely sober.
spending time with Logan, seeing her let me in, felt like an even bigger prize than winning the Cup.
She might be sandwiched between us, but she was telling me that she was mine. And I was hers.
The sight of it made me feral.
Apparently, she was just as possessive as I was. I fucking loved it.
While Boone licked the salt from the cleavage of one of the women, I dragged Logan back out to the dance floor.
We were good for each other. We challenged each other—both on the ice and in the bedroom.

facts.fact: 低估→夺冠逻辑迁移到爱情
facts.anchor: Everyone had underestimated us, and we’d won. If that was possible, then anything could be possible.

facts.fact: 结尾：巴士上假装朋友的煎熬
facts.anchor: Logan and Holden were deep in conversation about hockey, and I hated that I had to pretend she and I were just friends…when we were so much more.
